evidence: Shipped format (frozen task): gates render 1/1 binary and constraints 1/1 binary (gates/*/judge.toml:22), as scoring.toml [gates]=0.0 requires. Functional 44/44 binary: every row is a pass/fail behaviour with an explicit 'Fails if ...' bar and a control (e.g. hro_interview_full 'moving another single card into Interview is refused by the server ... Fails if ... accepted'; hro_thread_latest 'most recent 30 messages ... Fails if it shows all messages, the wrong 30'). No functional row grades degree of quality: grep for mostly/reasonably/clear/looks/polished/partial found only 'readable line naming who and what changed' (hro_activity, a presence check) and 'at the first look after the action' (hro_move_one_stage). Polish 5/5 binary: each is a discrete state-preservation outcome (draft text exact, document.activeElement, scroll offset unchanged, getBoundingClientRect().top within a few pixels, failed send not lost/duplicated, session-resume drafts per user) - pass/fail behaviours, so binary fits; no craft judgement is forced into binary. Visual 5/5 type='likert', points=5 (scored/visual/judge.toml:22-23, 37-38, 52-53, 67-68, 82-83), each with five described anchors 5..1 (25 anchor lines counted), covering typography, colour/contrast, spacing/layout, hierarchy, consistency - craft graded with gradation. Runtime fit: tests/Dockerfile:31 pins harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7, whose Likert.normalize is (raw-1)/(points-1) clamped and prompt_fragment 'an integer from 1 to 5'; the task's 1-5 anchors match that range exactly (the template's extra '0:' anchor, which would clamp, was correctly dropped). visual/prompt.md:7 says lowest score is 'binary 0; Likert 1', :12 'minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero', :20 NOT EXERCISED -> 'raw Likert1 (normalized zero)'; functional/polish/gate prompts use binary0 consistently. Workbook E42 internal note (binary+weighted, no likert) is resolved per SKILL.md known false positive: judge against shipped format; the presence of likert in visual is not a defect. Lessons file patterns checked for this row: lesson 2 (one weight scheme) - comment '1.0 standard, 1.5 important, 2.0 core ... (Visual Likert rows are equal)' and weights match (binary rows 1/1.5/2, visual all 1); lesson 6 checker-not-fixer present in all five prompts with likert-correct minimum; lesson 9 'Report every step' present in visual prompt (:16-18); lesson 11 infra crash mapped to minimum with NOT EXERCISED reason. Broken-app probe: a static shell or a no-op save fails the visual gate -> every likert row raw 1 = 0, every binary row 0; a pretty but static app cannot farm visual mass because the gate is checked first and the functional floor applies. Conforming-alternative probe: anchors are style-neutral ('Layout, labels and styles are the implementer's choice', visual/prompt.md:14), so a different but coherent design can score 5; binary rows accept alternative UIs (e.g. hro_refused_put_back lists three acceptable ways). No binary row penalises a craft difference and no likert block lacks anchors. Measurement: no configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope), so actual judge use of the integer scale is NOT EXERCISED; this row's verdict rests on the shipped schema and the pinned RewardKit semantics, which do not require that run.
